dict.string: Convert currency, units, time, percentages and more in natural language
now · +15 days · days until 31 december · 3pm utc · 1577836800
Enter a value to calculate VAT
#ff6600 · rgb(255, 102, 0) to hex · tomato to hsl
Delete cached exchange rates and crypto prices

**Calculate Anything** converts things in natural language, with no keyword: open Alfred and type a number.
A rebuild of [Calculate Anything by Biati Digital](https://github.com/biati-digital/alfred-calculate-anything) (archived in 2024). It needs no PHP and no API keys.
## Just type
- **Currency** `100 usd to idr` · `100 euros in dollars` · `100€ to $` · `150k idr to usd` · `100 eur` (to your base currencies) - **Cryptocurrency** `1 btc` · `2 bitcoins to dollars` · `5 bitcoins in ethereum` · `1eth btc` - **Units** `100 km to miles` · `100oz kg` · `-25F to C` · `4500 ft2 to m2` · `10 years to months` - **Data storage** `2 gb to mb` · `400MiB to kib` · `100 gigabytes in megabytes` - **Percentages** `120 + 30%` · `15% of 50` · `40 as a % of 50` · `20% off 150` - **px, em, rem, pt** `12px` · `2rem to pt` · `12px in em base 17px` - **VAT** `400 + vat` · `400 - vat`
## Keywords
- `time` `now` · `+15 days` · `days until 31 december` · `start of year` · `25 December 2021 - 31 December 2021` · `3pm utc` · `now in tokyo` · `1577836800` - `vat` `of 400` shows the tax, the amount with tax, and the amount before tax - `calc` any text, including `$25`, `Rp 1.500.000` and `USD 100 to IDR`. The **Calculate Anything** Universal Action and the optional hotkey send selected text here - `color` `#ff6600` · `rgb(255, 102, 0) to hex` · `tomato to hsl` - `_caclear` deletes the cached rates
## On a result
- **Return** copies the formatted value - **⌘ Return** copies it without formatting - **⌥ Return** copies the value of a single unit (or the value with its unit) - **⌃ Return** pastes it into the app you were using
Exchange rates: exchangerate-api.com, fawazahmed0/exchange-api, frankfurter.dev, European Central Bank. Crypto prices: coinpaprika.com, coingecko.com, coinlore.net.
Receives text from the Universal Action and the hotkey, and reads amounts written symbol first.
Unassigned. Set a key to convert the selected text.
Typing a number starts a conversion: no keyword needed. One trigger per digit.
Select text anywhere, open Universal Actions, choose Calculate Anything.
Return copies the formatted result. ⌘ Return copies it unformatted. ⌥ Return copies the single-unit value (or value with unit).
An amount written symbol first: $100 to idr, €50, £20, ¥1000.
⌃ Return pastes the result into the app you were using. Pasting needs Accessibility permission for Alfred.
Language for results and for the natural-language words you can type. English words always work.

Words from another language you can type on top of the Language above, such as Indonesian 500rb, 1,5jt ke usd, 5 ons and 1 tumbak. Automatic follows this Mac: a Mac set to Indonesia understands Indonesian.
Typing an amount with no target ("100 yen") converts to these, separated by commas. Leave empty to use this Mac's local currency plus USD, EUR and MYR.
Typing a unit with no target ("100 kg") converts to these, separated by commas. Kinds of unit you leave out convert to the other measurement system: kg to lb, km to mi, °F to °C.
Decimals shown for currency amounts. Enter -1 to show every decimal.
Decimals shown for amounts in a cryptocurrency. -1 shows every decimal.
How the time keyword writes dates, using PHP date letters (j F, Y, g:i:s a). Separate several formats with a pipe: j F, Y, g:i:s a | Y-m-d H:i:s
Whether the day or the month comes first when you type a date with slashes.
Indonesia's PPN is 11% on most goods and services and 12% on luxury goods. Type a rate in a query for a one-off, for example: vat 400 12%
Root font size for px, em and rem conversions.
Binary mode: treat 1 MB as 1024 kB
Off follows the IEC standard: 1 MB = 1000 kB and 1 MiB = 1024 KiB.
Hours between downloads of exchange rates. Empty means 6.
Hours between downloads of cryptocurrency prices. Empty means 0.25 (15 minutes).
Keyword for date and time calculations.
Keyword for any text, such as $25 or Rp 1.500.000. The Universal Action and the hotkey open it with the selected text.
Not needed: exchange rates come from free public sources. A fixer.io key, if you have one, is tried first.
Not needed: crypto prices come from free public sources. A coinmarketcap.com key, if you have one, is tried first.
